_comment: LandfallElementals (lfe-fury, 2026-10-18): Incandescent Soulstoke puts Fury from hand for {1}{R}, {T}.
The put creature gains haste and is pumped by Soulstoke's lord: a 4/4 DOUBLE STRIKER = exactly 8, the
opponent's life. Two Mountains cannot hard-cast Fury ({3}{R}{R}) and the hand holds no other red card, so
the pitch evoke is not castable either: the put is the ONLY lethal line. Guards the put's haste, the
lord's +1/+1 on a put creature, double strike in combat AND in the search's this-turn projection (the
put's attack stamp), and that the creature is put (not cast) through the real executor. The library is
a dead draw (Swords to Plowshares, no white mana) so the board stays fixed.
